rationale: The original short thesis relied on the stock staying below session VWAP and the 5-minute 9-EMA, but price has bounced off the $16.82 session low with rising volume on the latest 1-minute bar (25,974 shares) and reclaimed both VWAP ($16.93) and the 9-EMA ($16.94) at $16.95. Closing now cuts the trade for a negligible loss (-0.15%) after the structural breakdown failed to follow through, rather than waiting to get stopped out at $17.01. A flip to long is not warranted given the weak broader market (SPY -0.74%) and overhead resistance near $17.00-$17.11.
